verdict.rationale: The only CLI evidence is a single bare command string, `vercel ai-gateway coding-agents setup`, which implies the official Vercel CLI has an AI Gateway subcommand for wiring up coding agents. Docs also say the gateway 'connects supported coding agents', but nothing describes the CLI's scope or other commands. Missing for 10: documented CLI command reference, CLI coverage of keys/budgets/logs/models, installation and usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
